svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Hybrid network on AWS
svg.desc: Hybrid network on AWS. 12 components in 10 groups. Connections: Application servers to Customer gateway; Customer gateway to AWS Direct Connect; AWS Direct Connect to Direct Connect gateway; Direct Connect gateway to AWS Transit Gateway; Customer gateway to AWS Site-to-Site VPN; AWS Site-to-Site VPN to AWS Transit Gateway; AWS Transit Gateway to TGW attachment; TGW attachment to Amazon EKS; AWS Transit Gateway to TGW attachment; TGW attachment to Amazon EC2; AWS Transit Gateway to TGW attachment; TGW attachment to Route 53 Resolver.

text.tspan: A corporate data center reaches VPCs in three accounts through one Transit Gateway, over Direct Connect with Site-to-Site VPN as backup
